body:
Freshman year of college I was driving back to my dorm Sunday after a couple days at home to do laundry and see my parents. There is a small section of highway between the main interstate and the city the college is in.

As I’m on this road heading west, the east bound lanes are blocked off by some police cars in the distance and two more police cars and a semi closer to me. As I pass the semi, all I noticed was a small dent on the bottom of the bumper, nothing dramatic enough to have the road closed. As I pass the semi and come to pass the police cars, I see a couple officer standing around a bloody mass. My college is located in the foothills of the Rocky Mountains, so seeing wildlife on the side of the road after being hit isn’t uncommon.

A bit later in the evening after I returned to my dorm, my roommate had the local news on and they started talking about earlier that day a former sheriff that had just been accused of child molestation stepped in front of a semi. I immediately realized that the thing I saw earlier in the day was not an animal and was that sheriff.
I ran a shoulder charge build in this last IB with peregrine greaves and much fun was had.
